intro.heading: Two years of ministry, mentoring, and a master’s degree.
intro.text: Our purpose is to raise up and equip next-generation leaders for work in church ministry. CCC Church Residency combines focused leadership training and practical ministry experience with a graduate-level academic program, so you leave ready to serve your local church.

band.photoAlt: Residents walking together down a brick street in downtown Omaha

week.heading: What a typical week looks like.

items.label: Ministry
items.text: Hands-on work in your area of focus, plus training in the general skills every ministry leader needs.

items.label: Graduate school
items.text: Online coursework through Crown College, on your own schedule.

week.note: Cohort leadership development with your fellow residents is built into the rhythm of the week.

development.heading: Ministry takes more than one skill.
development.text: The residency is built to give you a well-rounded set of competencies for full-time church ministry.

items.title: Leadership development
points: Creating and casting mission and vision
Creating a reproducing, sending leadership culture

items.title: Ministry experience
points: Up-front communication like preaching and teaching
General pastoral duties like weddings and funerals
Creating a volunteer culture: recruiting, training, and retaining
Specialized skills in your area of focus

items.title: Biblical and theological education
points: Fully funded, including books and fees
Completed online alongside your ministry work

areas.heading: Choose your ministry area.
areas.text: Residents choose a primary area of focus and work with a mentor inside it, based on their calling, gifts, and passions.

items.title: Kids Ministry
items.text: Help children and their families build a foundation of faith.

items.title: Middle School and High School
items.text: Disciple students through the years that shape who they become.

items.title: College and Young Adults
items.text: Reach and disciple college students and young adults across Omaha.

items.title: Adult Discipleship
items.text: Help adults grow in their faith through groups, classes, and care.

items.title: Missions
items.text: Mobilize the church to serve locally and around the world.

items.title: Worship Arts
items.text: Lead worship and develop the musicians and teams behind it.

items.title: Communications and Creative
items.text: Tell the church’s story through design, video, writing, and digital media.

items.title: Tech and Production
items.text: Run the audio, video, and lighting behind services and events.

items.title: Counseling and Care
items.text: Walk with people toward healing. Pairs with the counseling degree tracks.

areas.note: Not sure yet? That’s fine. Tell us on your application.

degrees.heading: Pick your degree path.
degrees.text: Every degree is completed online through Crown College and is fully funded, including books and fees.

groups.label: Two-year residency
items: Master of Arts in Pastoral Counseling (non-licensure)
Crown 30 certificate: thirty credit hours of Bible and theology, for residents without a bachelor’s degree

groups.label: Three-year residency
items: Master of Arts in Counseling with state licensure

money.heading: How the money works.
money.text: Residents raise their own monthly support, and CCC matches it. Your degree is covered, and housing is available with a host family at no cost.

items.title: Raised support
items.text: Friends, family, and churches partner with you through monthly giving.

items.title: Church match
items.text: CCC matches the donations you raise, up to $400 a month.

items.title: Tuition
items.text: Your Crown College degree, books, and fees are fully funded.

items.title: Housing
items.text: Live with a CCC host family in a private room. No rent or utilities.

items.title: Transportation
items.text: Residents provide their own vehicle and transportation.

money.note: Friends and family who want to partner with a resident can [give online](/host-families/#support).
